1.0.11: Added lock screen / media controls: the play-pause button behaves like the main screen, notification reduced to artwork + playing text + a single button
Fixed the playing label disappearing after reopening the app
Fixed no sound when dragging the tune editor sliders
Fixed the play-pause button state not syncing after returning from settings
Battery savings: hour-aligned timer (1 wake-up per hour instead of 720) and cached audio skips network checks for 24 hours
Memory savings: smaller player buffers, on-demand language dictionaries, reused preview audio track, idle worker threads reclaimed
Build upgrade: Gradle 8.14.5, release builds now use R8 minification and resource shrinking (much smaller APK)
1.0.10: Added Population Growing - Rainy Day, will always play the same tune
Added label when minimized to tray to view the current tune's game and name
Added Open on startup option (thanks NoodleSushi!)
1.0.9: Added Wild World to City Folk label
1.0.7: Fix windows issue where if closed with the context menu or alt+f4 it wouldn't close
